title: AI layer follow-ups after budget-ucyr: rate limit on /ai routes, Z.ai error reporting, OpenAI models that cannot do json_schema or tools, log upstream error code
description: From the third review (attached review-ucyr-2.md), items not fixed in budget-ucyr: F2 no rate limit on /ai test/models (a user can loop paid Z.ai checks on the shared key and use up its concurrency); a mistyped Z.ai model answers 502 upstream_error instead of a model error; zero balance reads as rate limiting. F3 a provider 403 on chat (e.g. OpenRouter moderation) reads as a bad key. F4 a timeout answers 502 although a timeout code exists; response body has no size cap; untested abort during body read. F5 log the provider's short error code through an allow-list. F6 redaction misses foo_sk-... and non-standard Z.ai shapes. F7 OpenAI filter keeps models without json_schema or tools (gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4, o1-mini, o1-preview, gpt-5-search-api): verify in docs. Anthropic verify walks up to 5 pages.
